lines.zh: 海浪轻拍我厚实的鳞甲，我缓缓游动。
lines.en: Waves caress my thick scales as I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 我的鳍轻轻划过水面，寻找食物。
lines.en: My fins gently glide through the water, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 海藻在我身旁轻轻摇曳，我悠然前行。
lines.en: Kelp sways by as I move gracefully.

lines.zh: 棕色的鳞片保护我免受伤害，我悠闲地游动。
